lureTypeLike: {type} type like most of the group, but {instead}

type.label: {type} type
type.rule: Every one is {type} type (alone or with another type).
type.lureColour: its Pokédex colour is {colour}, but it's {types}, not {type}
type.lureKin: its relative {kin} is {type} type, but {name} is {types}

pure.label: Pure {type} type
pure.rule: {type} is their one and only type.

gen.label: Debuted in Gen {gen} ({region})
gen.rule: All first appeared in Generation {gen}, the {region} games.
gen.lure: its relative {kin} is from Gen {gen}, but {name} came in Gen {own}

legendary.label: Legendary Pokémon
legendary.lureMythical: Mythical, which isn't the same as Legendary
legendary.lureBst: a base stat total of {bst}, but not Legendary

mythical.label: Mythical Pokémon
mythical.rule: All are Mythical Pokémon, the event-only kind.

baby.label: Baby Pokémon
baby.rule: All are baby Pokémon, the pre-evolutions that hatch from Eggs.
baby.lure: {baby} is the baby; {name} is what it grows into

noEvo.label: Doesn't evolve
noEvo.rule: None of them evolves or evolves from anything.

stone.label: Evolved with a stone
stone.rule: Each one is reached by using an evolution stone on its pre-evolution.
stone.oneRule: Each one evolves from its pre-evolution with {stone}.
stone.lureInto: it uses {stone} to evolve into {into}, but wasn't evolved by one

trade.label: Trade evolutions
trade.rule: Each one is reached by trading its pre-evolution.
trade.whyFor: evolves from {from} by trade for a {pokemon}
trade.lureInto: it evolves into {into} by trade, but isn't a trade evolution itself
trade.lureHeld: it evolves while holding an item ({item}), but by levelling up, not trading
trade.lureHeldTime: it evolves while holding an item ({item}, {time}), but by levelling up, not trading

friendship.label: Friendship evolutions
friendship.rule: Each one evolves from its pre-evolution by levelling up with high friendship.
friendship.lure: it evolves into {into} by friendship, but isn't a friendship evolution itself

ability.label: Can have {ability}
ability.rule: Every one can have the Ability {ability} (Hidden Abilities count).

move.label: Learns {move} by level-up
move.rule: Every one learns {move} by levelling up in Scarlet & Violet.
move.lure: a {type} type, but it doesn't learn {move}

top.label: Highest stat: {stat}
top.rule: {stat} is every one's single highest base stat.

bst.highRule: Their base stats add up to 600 or more.
bst.lowRule: Their base stats add up to less than 260.
bst.lureHigh: a base stat total of {bst}, just short of 600
bst.lureLow: a base stat total of {bst}, just over 260

body.heavyRule: Each one weighs at least 300 kg.
body.lightRule: Each one weighs 1 kg or less.
body.tallRule: Each one is at least 3 m tall.
body.shortRule: None of them is taller than 0.3 m.

colour.label: Pokédex colour: {Colour}
colour.rule: The Pokédex files every one of them under the colour {colour}.

form.label: Has {region} form
form.lureKin: its relative {kin} has {region} form, but {name} doesn't

mega.label: Can Mega Evolve
mega.rule: Each one has a Mega Evolution (Legends: Z-A's new Megas included).
mega.lure: it has a Gigantamax form, not a Mega Evolution

gmax.label: Has a Gigantamax form
gmax.lure: it can Mega Evolve, but has no Gigantamax form

egg.label: {group} Egg Group
egg.rule: Every one is in the {group} Egg Group.
egg.lure: {n, plural, one {its Egg Group is} other {its Egg Groups are}} {groups}

gender.maleRule: Every one of them is always male.
gender.maleLureMostly: male 87.5% of the time, but not always
gender.femaleRule: Every one of them is always female.
gender.noneRule: None of them has a gender.

letter.label: Starts with {letter}
letter.rule: Every name begins with the letter {letter}.

short.label: Four letters or fewer
short.rule: Every name is four letters long or shorter.

symbol.label: Not just letters
symbol.rule: Every name has something besides letters: a space, a dot, a hyphen, an apostrophe, a colon, an accent, a digit or a symbol.

wordplay.colourLabel: Hides a colour in its name
wordplay.colourRule: Every name has a colour tucked inside it: {words}.
wordplay.bodyLabel: Hides a body part in its name
wordplay.bodyRule: Every name has a body part tucked inside it: an arm, a toe, an ear, a fin...
wordplay.wordRule: Every name is, or starts with, a plain English word: slow, star, bell, bear...
wordplay.rhymeRule: Every name ends in the same letters: -{ending}.

lore.aceRule: Each is the final, strongest Pokémon of a Gym Leader in the main games.
lore.boxRule: Each is the legendary Pokémon on the cover of a main-series game.
lore.foodRule: Each name is built from a food: apple, cherry, vanilla, pumpkin, chestnut, dough, olive, tea, egg, peach...
lore.foodWhy: its English name comes from a food
lore.moveRule: Each learns a move that no other evolution family can learn.

mixed.label: {type}-related
mixed.rule: Each tile goes with the {type} type: a {type}-type Pokémon, a {type}-type move, an ability found mostly on {type}-type Pokémon, or the {type} type itself.
mixed.ability: an ability that mostly belongs to {type}-type Pokémon
